About I’m an associate professor of Computer Science at Université Grenoble Alpes, teaching at IM2AG (UGA) and Ensimag (Grenoble INP).
I conduct my research within the GAIA team at GIPSA-lab. My research interests include Bayesian inference, statistical signal processing, probabilistic learning, multifractal analysis, and applications in medical imaging.
Before joining Université Grenoble Alpes, I was a postdoctoral research associate at CREATIS and Université Claude Bernard Lyon 1 from 2023 to 2025, working with Adrian Basarab. Since January 2025, I have been a member of the EURASIP Academy.

[09/2025] New Position.
Joined Université Grenoble Alpes and GIPSA-lab as Associate Professor of Computer Science.
[2025–2027] Research Grant.
The project Advanced Robust Estimation and Performance Bounds was selected for the Université Grenoble Alpes research support program for new faculty members.
[07/2025] Journal Paper.
Our paper “A Weighted Hankel Approach and Cramér–Rao Bound Analysis for Quantitative Acoustic Microscopy Imaging” was published in Computers in Biology and Medicine.
[04/2025] Plenary Talk.
Invited plenary speaker at the Randomness and Fractals meeting in Vannes, France, with the talk “Multivariate Multifractal Parameter Estimation Using Bayesian Inference”.

Chaired the Biomedical Image Processing session and coordinated the student volunteer team at EUSIPCO 2024 in Lyon, France.
2023 [05/2023] Journal Paper.
Our paper “Bounds for the Estimation of Matrix-Valued Parameters of a Gaussian Random Process” was published in Signal Processing.
[03/2023] New Position.
Joined CREATIS and Université Claude Bernard Lyon 1 as a postdoctoral research associate, working on data science for quantitative acoustic microscopy.
2022 [12/2022] PhD.
Completed my PhD in Signal Processing at the National Polytechnic Institute of Toulouse, with a thesis on Bayesian estimation for multivariate multifractal analysis.
[06/2022] Journal Paper.
Our paper “A Bayesian framework for multivariate multifractal analysis” was published in IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing.
2019 [01/2019] Fellowship.
Awarded a CARMIN–IHP–CIMPA Fellowship to participate in the Mathematics of Imaging thematic program at the Institut Henri Poincaré in Paris.
